paragraphs.text: • Blind Transit & Delays: Over 150,000 annual ambulance deaths occur due to uncoordinated hospital selection and fatal admission delays. • Read-Only Static Portals: Current state dashboards show what existed hours ago — reading a portal is NOT reserving a bed. • Ghost Bed Paradox: Portals display raw physical frames while hiding that zero on-duty nurses are present to staff ICU beds.

paragraphs.text: OUR SOLUTION• Situational First-Aid: Gives bystanders live, step-by-step guidance (Semi-Fowler 45°, 300mg aspirin) en route to halt early collapse. • Route to nearest hospital: Our app shows you the nearest hospital with specific beds or blood and helps reserve bed/blood for You.• Zero-Signup Instant Access: Web PWA loads in <0.8s on any smartphone browser with zero app download or password barrier. • Staffed Bed Reservation: Strictly computes usable beds as Staffed Beds = min(Physical Beds, Nurses × Ratio) with dynamic GPS lock. • Instant Vernacular Triage: Categorizes acuity (ESI-1 to ESI-5) via voice in Bengali, Hinglish, or English with zero cloud latency.

paragraphs.text: FOUR-TIER OPERATIONAL RISKS

• Bed Hoarding by Touts: Solved by 50% public hold cap, client risk engine, and 100m physical geofence gate. • Night Nurse Fatigue: Solved by 1-tap adjusters that dynamically recompute beds and activate ICU surge limits. • Traffic Jams & Expirations: Solved by live GPS vector tracking that pauses the countdown while moving toward the ER. • Patient Data Privacy: Solved by ephemeral encrypted telemetry with automatic purge 60 minutes post-admission.
